in_marathi.name: Vindhya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vindhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vindhya refers to the mountain range that separates the northern and southern parts of India. It is believed to be the abode of various Hindu gods and goddesses, and is considered a symbol of protection and strength.
